summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed method, and speed rendering for unknown-total tasks; track() gained a show_speed option (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total as None for unsized iterables instead of raising. Updated tests/test_progress.py (removed the two ValueError assertions, added test_task_progress_column_speed) and added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased / Added. Nothing was run or type-checked, per the instructions, and no commits were made.
